look_here_first: Inspect opposite, thick, glossy leaves 3–6 inches long: look for a distinct opaque 1–2 mm rim at the blade edge and 6–8 pairs of lateral veins. Confirm large terminal flower/fruit panicles and woody tree-like habit.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Broadleaf evergreen shrub or small tree; can reach a large tree-like crown.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Opposite, simple, entire, thick and glossy, usually 3–6 inches long; conspicuous opaque margin rim, 6–8 pairs of lateral veins; veins sunken beneath.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Small white four-lobed flowers borne in large terminal panicles, roughly 5–8 inches long.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Numerous blue-black drupes in persistent terminal panicles.

key_traits.label: Stems
key_traits.text: Tan twigs with lenticels; leaves largely glabrous.
